paragraphs: R' Chanina, son of R' Yishmael.
Mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 38:8 and Pesikta Rabbati, Acharei Mot 4.[^1]

notes.text: ש״ר פ״לח־ח and פ׳ רבתי פ׳ אחרי מות־ד are read as Shemot Rabbah chapter 38 section 8 and Pesikta Rabbati, Acharei Mot 4. The latter פ׳ is not forced into parashah rather than piska; neither locus is independently checked against a named edition. The complete son-of relation remains; both title abbreviations remain R', without importing catalog רבי.
